items: Launched on 9th May 2015 by the Finance Ministry, aims to provide a minimum pension to workers
in the unorganized sector after the age of 60.
o Eligibility: Workers aged 18-40 years from the unorganized sector.
o Pension Amount: Fixed between ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after 60.
o Contribution: Requires a minimum of 20 years of contribution.
o Government Co-contribution: 50% of the premium or ₹1,000 (whichever is lower) for the
o Tax: Income tax payers and government employees are not eligible.
o Exit: In case of death before 60, the nominee gets the accumulated amount.
